previous.en: The previous chapter explains the background needed for this discussion.
previous.zh: 前一章說明這次討論所需的背景。

prey.en: Small fish often become prey for larger animals in the lake.
prey.zh: 小魚常成為湖中較大型動物的獵物。

priceless.en: The family considered the old letters priceless because of their history.
priceless.zh: 這家人因那些老信件的歷史意義而視其為無價之寶。

pride.en: She took pride in completing the difficult project with her team.
pride.zh: 她為和團隊完成困難專題感到自豪。

prime.en: The station's prime location makes it easy for students to visit.
prime.zh: 車站的絕佳位置讓學生很容易前往。

primitive.en: The exhibit compares primitive tools with later metal designs.
primitive.zh: 展覽比較早期簡單工具與後來的金屬設計。

prince.en: The story follows a prince who travels beyond the palace walls.
prince.zh: 故事描述一位王子走出宮牆旅行。

princess.en: The novel presents the princess as a curious and capable leader.
princess.zh: 小說把這位公主描寫成好奇且有能力的領導者。

printer.en: The classroom printer ran out of paper before lunch.
printer.zh: 教室印表機在午餐前用完紙張。

privacy.en: Students should protect their privacy when using online services.
privacy.zh: 學生使用線上服務時應保護自己的隱私。

privatize.en: The article discusses whether governments should privatize certain public services.
privatize.zh: 文章討論政府是否應將某些公共服務民營化。

privilege.en: Access to a quiet study space can feel like a privilege.
privilege.zh: 能使用安靜的讀書空間有時像是一種難得的條件。

prize.en: Her science project won first prize at the school fair.
prize.zh: 她的科學專題在校內展覽獲得首獎。

probable.en: Rain is probable this afternoon according to the latest forecast.
probable.zh: 根據最新預報，今天下午很可能下雨。

probe.en: The space probe sent new images back to scientists on Earth.
probe.zh: 太空探測器把新影像傳回地球給科學家。

procession.en: A colorful procession moved slowly through the town during the festival.
procession.zh: 節慶期間，一支繽紛隊伍緩慢穿過城鎮。

proclaim.en: The organizers will proclaim the contest winners after the final performance.
proclaim.zh: 主辦單位會在最後演出後宣布比賽得獎者。

producer.en: The film producer visited our class to discuss documentary work.
producer.zh: 電影製作人到班上分享紀錄片工作。

production.en: The factory reduced waste while increasing production this year.
production.zh: 工廠今年在提高產量的同時減少廢棄物。

productive.en: A quiet morning gave us several productive hours for group work.
productive.zh: 安靜的早晨讓我們有幾個有效率的小組工作時段。

productivity.en: Short breaks can improve productivity during long periods of study.
productivity.zh: 長時間讀書時，短暫休息能提升效率。

profession.en: Teaching is a profession that requires preparation, patience, and communication.
profession.zh: 教學是一項需要準備、耐心與溝通的專業。

professor.en: The visiting professor answered student questions after the lecture.
professor.zh: 客座教授在演講後回答學生問題。

proficiency.en: Regular reading can improve proficiency in academic English over time.
proficiency.zh: 規律閱讀能逐漸提升學術英文能力。

profile.en: The website lets each student update a personal learning profile.
profile.zh: 網站讓每位學生更新自己的學習資料頁。

profit.en: The shop donated part of its profit to the community library.
profit.zh: 商店把部分利潤捐給社區圖書館。

profitable.en: The small business became profitable after improving its delivery service.
profitable.zh: 這家小企業改善配送服務後開始獲利。

progress.en: The teacher praised our progress after several weeks of practice.
progress.zh: 經過數週練習後，老師稱讚我們的進步。

progressive.en: The course uses a progressive series of tasks from simple to complex.
progressive.zh: 這門課使用由簡入繁的漸進式任務。

projection.en: The chart shows a projection of population growth over ten years.
projection.zh: 圖表顯示未來十年人口成長的預測。

prolong.en: Unnecessary delays may prolong the project beyond the original schedule.
prolong.zh: 不必要的延誤可能讓專題超出原定時程。

promising.en: The early results look promising, but more testing is still needed.
promising.zh: 初步結果看來很有希望，但仍需要更多測試。

promote.en: The campaign aims to promote reading among younger students.
promote.zh: 這項活動旨在鼓勵年幼學生閱讀。

promotion.en: The bookstore offered a promotion on dictionaries during the school season.
promotion.zh: 書店在開學季推出字典促銷活動。

prone.en: This low area is prone to flooding after very heavy rain.
prone.zh: 這片低窪地區在大雨後容易淹水。

pronounce.en: The teacher showed us how to pronounce the unfamiliar name clearly.
pronounce.zh: 老師示範如何清楚念出那個陌生名字。

pronunciation.en: Listening carefully can improve pronunciation and speaking confidence over time.
pronunciation.zh: 仔細聆聽能逐漸改善發音與口說信心。

proof.en: The scientist asked for stronger proof before accepting the conclusion.
proof.zh: 科學家要求更有力的證據後才接受結論。

propel.en: A steady wind can propel a small sailboat across the lake.
propel.zh: 穩定的風能推動小帆船穿過湖面。

property.en: The library asks visitors to respect public property and shared equipment.
property.zh: 圖書館請訪客愛惜公共財物與共用設備。

proposal.en: Our group submitted a proposal for a new recycling station.
proposal.zh: 我們小組提交設置新回收站的提案。

propose.en: I propose moving the meeting to Friday after school.
propose.zh: 我提議把會議改到星期五放學後。

prose.en: The author writes clear prose even when discussing complicated ideas.
prose.zh: 即使討論複雜觀念，作者的散文文字仍很清楚。

prospective.en: Prospective students toured the campus before choosing their programs.
prospective.zh: 準學生在選擇課程前參觀校園。

prosper.en: Local shops can prosper when the neighborhood attracts more visitors.
prosper.zh: 當社區吸引更多訪客時，在地商店可能蓬勃發展。

prosperity.en: The history lesson examines trade and prosperity in the coastal city.
prosperity.zh: 歷史課探討這座沿海城市的貿易與繁榮。

prosperous.en: The port grew into a prosperous trading center over several decades.
prosperous.zh: 這座港口在數十年間發展成繁榮的貿易中心。

protection.en: Wetlands provide natural protection against flooding in some coastal areas.
protection.zh: 濕地能為某些沿海地區提供天然防洪保護。

protective.en: The lab requires protective goggles during certain science activities.
protective.zh: 進行某些科學活動時，實驗室要求配戴防護眼鏡。

protein.en: The nutrition lesson explained that protein supports normal growth and repair.
protein.zh: 營養課說明蛋白質有助於正常生長與修復。
